summary: A newspaper story prompts the library chair to call a meeting outside the regular schedule.
realLife: After a Greenville newspaper report drew public concern about internet use, the library trustees convened a special meeting to hear from the community.
inGame: needs: public report and meeting notice.

turns.pulledBy: The regular meeting is still weeks away.
turns.what: The chair calls a special session.
turns.writesBack: Residents have an earlier date to speak.

turns.pulledBy: The board already has a public hearing scheduled.
turns.what: The clerk adds the notice to the regular hearing materials.
turns.writesBack: Residents can bring the concern there.
